source.check: every figure read from the two page images

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1958: nominations 20 May 1958; six contests, polled 5 June 1958. The outgoing member in Moyra Castle was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph nominations list. Polled 5 June 1958. Magee was the outgoing member. The Armagh Guardian prints 95 for Magee; the Newry Telegraph and Newry Reporter both print 93, which agrees with 245 votes cast.
